{{Quote|From Tython, the children of the Je'daii spread out across the Tython system. Traveling toward toward the sun, they settled on Sunspot and Malterra, Nox, and arid Krev Coueur. Beyond Tython, they settled first on Kalimahr, jewel of the Tython system, then Shikaakwa, the outlaw world, then on forest planet Ska Gora, and on the moons of the giants&mdash;Obri and Mawr&mdash;and even the outermost planet, cold Furies Gate.|Ketu|<ref name="Dawn 1" />}}
The '''Tython system''', also known as the '''Tythan system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. Centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tythos]], the system contained eleven [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], which was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Je'daii Order]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the founding of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The system was settled for a [[Time/Legends|time]] by the [[Kwa/Legends|Kwa]] in the millennia before the [[Tho Yor Arrival]] in [[36,453 BBY]], when the eight great pyramid ships known as the [[Tho Yor]] brought [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] pilgrims of many different [[Species/Legends|species]] to Tython to study [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Over a thousand years later, the non-Force-sensitive [[Tythan]]s spread out over the [[Settled Worlds]], as the system's planets became known.

==Description==
The Tython [[Star system/Legends|system]],<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> also known as the Tythan system,<ref name="Void" /> was located within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region.<ref name="Atlas" /> The [[Settled Worlds]] were spread over sixteen billion [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].<ref name="Void" />

==History==
Around 29,000 BBY, the Tythans conducted a series of exploratory missions to Sunspot, hoping to discover signs of habitation that would prove that the planet did not originate in the Tython system but was in fact a rogue planet caught in Tythos's gravity. However, the missions were ultimately unsuccessful.<ref name="Void" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the sectors of the Galactic Republic were assigned one of twenty [[Oversector/Legends|oversectors]], and were the operating theaters of the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] fighting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], with the Tython system being assigned to [[Sector 5/Legends|Sector 5]], which was defended by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Fifth Deep Core Army]].<ref name="TEGTW" /> After establishing the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] implemented the [[Tarkin Doctrine/Legends|Tarkin Doctrine]], reorganizing the oversectors into political as well as military entities, giving each Imperial [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] command over an oversector.<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> Grand Moff [[Cinzero Gann]] was given command of Sector 5.<ref name="Shield">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>

==Orbital bodies==
===Sunspot===
{{Main|Sunspot (Tython system)}}
[[File:Sunspot.jpg|left]]
Sunspot was a small planet that was the closest to Tythos in the system,<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> though it moved along its orbit in a direction opposite that of the other planets in the system, and it was believed by [[Tythan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] that Sunspot was actually a "rogue" planetoid that had been caught in Tythos's gravitational pull. Sunspot's orbit took it as close as forty-eight million kilometers from Tythos at times, and much of the planet's surface was in constant turmoil as it was racked by gravitational forces that caused violent seismic and volcanic activity. [[Petonium]] and [[marionium]], elements that were used to power ships' drives, were among the elements found on Sunspot. Most of the planet's settlers lived at the poles in scattered mining communities, and 10% of those who came to Sunspot seeking their fortune [[Death/Legends|died]] there&mdash;most miners only lasted one or two seasons before they left the world. Sunspot's surface was covered by volcano ranges and magma lakes and rivers, and the clouds of noxious gas occasionally led the planet to have a pinkish hue from space.<ref name="Void" /> Sunspot and Malterra's orbits caused the planets to pass very close to each other at a certain point, resulting in violent storms on both planets<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> as they passed within half a million kilometers of each other.<ref name="Void" /> Sunspot's surface was extremely hot, but the Tythans developed environment suits that allowed them to conduct mining operations on the planet's surface.<ref name="DOTJ 0" />

===Malterra===
{{Main|Malterra}}
[[File:Malterra.jpg|left]]
Malterra was the second planet closest to Tythos in the system. When the small planet passed Sunspot, the planet closest to Tythos, in its orbit, violent storms were often experienced. While it was known to have an extremely hot climate, many non–Force-sensitive settlers still colonized Malterra, more than thirty-six thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="DOTJ 0" />

===Mawr===
{{Main|Mawr}}
'''Mawr''' was the tenth planet in the Tython system, a large [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] with seven moons that was one of the two largest in the system along with Obri. An orb of black and reddish orange gas, Mawr was known as one of "the Giants" along with Obri. Several gas-[[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities had been established in Mawr's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] by the year [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> and Mawr's moons were colonized by the Tythans during the [[second migration]].<ref name="Dawn 1" />

===Furies Gate===
{{Main|Furies Gate}}
[[File:Furies_Gate.jpg|left]]
'''Furies Gate''' was the outermost planet in the Tython system, and it was a barren world less than a third of the size of Tython that was unsettled apart from [[Fury Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in orbit of the planet. Fury Station was a scientific outpost,<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> and also served as a launch point for several of the [[Sleeper ship/Legends|sleeper ships]] that the Tythans sent out into the galaxy,<ref name="DOTJ 2">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 2]]</ref> which eventually settled [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> Furies Gate featured a barren red surface and lacked any moons, and its distance from Tythos led it to be a cold world.<ref name="DOTJ 0" />
